title: Dekh shireen
body:
ran mein laashe hai pade naizon pe sar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa tere ghar aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baal chehre pe hai jiske teri shehzadi hai
jiske shaano pe nishan rassi ka faryadi hai
kitne nashtar dile zainab mein utar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ka pehra kabhi abbas diya karte thay
naukri jinki malayek aake kiya karte thay
tere ghar aaj wohi khaak basar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunsa hashr ka manzar na nighaon mein phira
sar bhi naize se sar e raah kayi baar gira
dekh kis haal mein hashim ke qamar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath seene pe dhare baithi hai umme laila
dard jo dil mein hai tab hogaya wo aur zyada
jab bhi qaatil ali akbar ke naar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne daalaan mein daala hai ye kiska jhoola
teer se chidh gaya maqtal mein gala asghar ka
cheh mahine ke hai naize pe magar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sakina hai jo sehmi hui baithi hai wahan
jaa ke nazdeek zara dekh tamachon ke nashan
sar pe chadar hai na kaano ke gohar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme farwa ko bhi pursa do zara qasim ka
gham na bhoolegi kabhi karbobala qasim ka
laash bhi tukdon mein taqseem jo kar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh zanjeeron mein jakda hai tera shehzada
phupiyan beparda hai uth'ta nahi sar abid ka
le ke kunbe ke ujadne ki khabar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne aamir tujhe ye deeda e nam baksha hai
dar pe ghazi ne bula kar ye qalam baksha hai
tab tere misron mein nayyar ye asar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
